prd_questions.answer: Both retained EVENT acquisitions have accepted frozen-policy candidate anomaly evidence (April3 88/P794; April28 7/P802). This is not a statistical significance test or confirmed HAB.

Accepted temporal deviations and family evidence explain the selected candidates: April3 predominantly F2/F5, with one F1/F2 region; April28 F2/F4. Descriptive family evidence is not measured chlorophyll; red-edge and spectral components overlap.

Candidate presence exists in both retained April acquisitions, but accepted exact-grid recurrence is 0/7 with history coverage7/7 over25days+8seconds. Biological persistence, motion-tracked continuity and POST/recovery are not established.
April28 accepted Watch29.52380952380953 is supported. April3 has no accepted AS107 score or band; do not infer one.

Exact onset-relative warning lead time is not estimable from month-level event timing. April3 is earliest evaluable candidate evidence among the two retained event-month observations, not a claim about all April acquisitions or days before onset.
